+namespace Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Runtime;
+
+/// <summary>
+/// The one finite startup deadline for a complete environment.
+/// </summary>
+/// <param name="TimeoutSeconds">The deadline length in seconds, measured from the start request.</param>
+/// <param name="IsOverride">True when a module declared the deadline; false for the default.</param>
+/// <param name="Justification">The declaration justification, when <paramref name="IsOverride"/> is true.</param>
+/// <param name="ModuleId">The module that declared the selected override.</param>
+public sealed record CompositionEffectiveDeadline(
+    double TimeoutSeconds,
+    bool IsOverride,
+    string? Justification,
+    string? ModuleId)
+{
+    /// <summary>Gets the deadline as a finite time span.</summary>
+    public TimeSpan Timeout => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(TimeoutSeconds);
+}

+namespace Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Runtime;

+using Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Workspace;
+
+/// <summary>
+/// Selects the project build configuration for a composed run.
+/// </summary>
+public static class CompositionLaunchConfiguration
+{
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Gets the <c>dotnet run</c> configuration for source or debug launch.
+    /// </summary>
+    /// <param name="mode">The tool-selected workspace mode.</param>
+    /// <param name="debugAttach">True when the command is <c>debug</c>.</param>
+    /// <returns><c>Debug</c> for source mode and for debug attach; otherwise <c>Release</c>.</returns>
+    public static string ProjectConfiguration(WorkspaceMode mode, bool debugAttach) =>
+        debugAttach || mode == WorkspaceMode.Source ? "Debug" : "Release";
+}

+namespace Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Runtime;
+
+/// <summary>
+/// The latest per-resource readiness observations written while startup is still in progress.
+/// </summary>
+/// <param name="Schema">The progress schema identity.</param>
+/// <param name="RunId">The run identity.</param>
+/// <param name="Resources">The latest result for every required resource.</param>
+public sealed record CompositionReadinessProgress(
+    string Schema,
+    string RunId,
+    IReadOnlyList<CompositionResourceReadiness> Resources)
+{
+    /// <summary>The supported progress schema identity.</summary>
+    public const string SupportedSchema = "hexalith.g4-readiness-progress.v1";
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Gets the progress document path in a run workspace.
+    /// </summary>
+    /// <param name="workspace">The run workspace.</param>
+    /// <returns>The absolute document path.</returns>
+    public static string PathFor(string workspace) => Path.Combine(workspace, "readiness-progress.json");
+}
